body: WhisperX:  Automatic Speech Recognition with Word-level Timestamps (& Diarization)
plain_description: **Turn audio into fast, searchable transcripts with word-level timing and speaker labels.** Transcribe long recordings in batches and export aligned segments. Run it from the command line or integrate it into Python workflows.
technical_description: WhisperX provides batched automatic speech recognition with word-level timestamps, using forced phoneme alignment and voice activity detection. It supports speaker diarization through pyannote, multilingual transcription, and CPU or CUDA GPU execution. Install with pip or uvx; Python APIs are also documented. Large-v2 can run at up to 70× realtime, and the README notes it requires under 8 GB of GPU memory with the faster-whisper backend.
title: WhisperX
